taxWithheld.title: Tax withheld
taxWithheld.explainer: Under Decree 117/2025/ND-CP, XePrime withholds and remits VAT and PIT for owners who are individuals or household businesses (verified companies are not withheld): self-drive and long-term 5% + 2%, with driver 3% + 1.5% of the rental amount, excluding the delivery fee. Tax is deducted from what XePrime owes you, never added to the customer price, and only accrues once a trip has started.
